items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: I know snow. Snow was the head man of the Lincoln Park... I didn't hardly see him. He was here. All I could hear is his name, Snow.

ctx.x: Do you know? No, I don't know. I don't know.
I know snow. Snow was the head man of the Lincoln Park. My name was Buck. I know. Hmm. Snow was the head man. What did he do?

Did he just ran the place? Did he do anything else? No, he didn't. I didn't know what he got. He was the boss around there. Yeah, that's it. You can't run this thing. You can't run this thing. You can't run the white man.
